title: 第3章 虎落平阳被犬欺第4章 林家找上门来
content_zh:
少年年龄和陆宸差不多，长相普通，皮肤有点黑，国字脸，身上穿着一套普通的衣服。
通过上一任的记忆，任逍遥知道眼前这个少年叫陆战，今年十五岁，是四叔陆狂的儿子。
上一任陆家家主陆啸天膝下生有四子，长子陆乾，二子陆蒙，三子陆毅，四子则是陆狂。
陆家四子中，老大陆乾和老二陆蒙亲近，老四陆狂从小崇拜老三陆毅，和陆毅关系极好。
在武道天赋上，陆毅最好，其次陆狂，陆蒙和陆乾武道天赋比较平庸，至今一个六重武师境，一个七重武师境。
陆毅被废前，陆毅是陆家第一强者，陆毅被废后，有着上品土属性玄脉的陆狂成了陆家第一强者。
和陆狂一样，陆战从小亲近陆宸，视陆宸为偶像，陆宸被废后，陆战是除了陆毅和陆狂外唯一关心陆宸的人。
不过，陆战似乎并没有遗传到陆狂在武道上的天赋，他的天赋很差，只有下品土属性黄脉。
这种武道天赋别说在四大家族，就是在普通武者中，那也是垫底的存在，十五岁了，武道才突破三重武徒境。
进门后，陆战把饭菜放到了床头的桌子上，之后，他来到陆宸的床边，一脸关心的问道：“宸哥，你今天好一点了吗？”
任逍遥看着陆战问道：“战弟，如果我就这样一直躺下去，你怎么办？”
陆战道：“宸哥，如果你一直这样，我就一直照顾你，绝对不让任何人欺负你，更不会让你饿着。”
任逍遥点了点头：“好，扶我起来吧。”
陆战看着全身包成粽子的陆宸担心道：“宸哥，你伤势重，还是躺着吧，别牵动了伤口，我来喂你。”
说着，陆战也不等任逍遥答应，端起饭菜一口一口的喂给陆宸。
陆宸倒也没拒绝，接受着陆战的照顾。
看着眼前小心翼翼的陆战，任逍遥的心里多了一丝暖意。
在这个以武为尊的世界，趋炎附势的人很多，但在你落难时能够做到不离不弃的人却是太少了。
陆宸虽然悲惨，但是他有这样一个兄弟也是不错了。
不知不觉间，任逍遥想到了自己的那些兄弟。

百年前，他们便已是一方巨擘，如今百年过去了，他变成了弱渣，他们应该成为神武界至强者了吧。
砰！
突然，房门被人一脚踹开，打破了和谐的氛围，紧接着五个男子气势汹汹的从外面进来。
踹门的是一个青年，此人面容消瘦，年龄二十出头，穿着不凡，武道为三重武士境。
他叫陆鸣，是当下陆家家主陆乾的小儿子。
和他一起来的四人年龄更大，但实力不如青年，都是武徒境，穿着朴素，都是陆鸣的追随者。
陆宸被废前，陆鸣虽然嫉妒陆宸，但是因为忌惮陆宸的实力，倒也不敢对陆宸有任何的放肆。
content_en:
The boy is about the same age as Lu Chen. He has an ordinary appearance, a bit dark skin, a Chinese character face, and is wearing a set of ordinary clothes.
Through the memory of his previous appointment, Ren Xiaoyao knew that the young man in front of him was called Lu Zhan. He was fifteen years old and was the son of his fourth uncle Lu Kuang.
The previous head of the Lu family, Lu Xiaotian, had four sons, the eldest son Lu Qian, the second son Lu Meng, the third son Lu Yi, and the fourth son Lu Kuang.
Among the four sons of the Lu family, the old Lu Luqian is close to the second son Lu Meng. The fourth son Lu Kuang has admired the third son Lu Yi since he was a child and has a very good relationship with Lu Yi.
In terms of martial arts talent, Lu Yi is the best, followed by Lu Kuang, Lu Meng and Lu Qian, whose martial arts talents are relatively mediocre. So far, they are at the sixth level and the seventh level.
Before Lu Yi was deposed, Lu Yi was the strongest person in the Lu family. After Lu Yi was deposed, Lu Kuang, who had high-grade earth attribute profound veins, became the strongest person in the Lu family.
Like Lu Kuang, Lu Zhan had been close to Lu Chen since childhood and regarded Lu Chen as his idol. After Lu Chen was deposed, Lu Zhan was the only person who cared about Lu Chen besides Lu Yi and Lu Kuang.
However, Lu Zhan didn't seem to inherit Lu Kuang's talent in martial arts. His talent was very poor and he only had low-grade earth attribute yellow veins.
This kind of martial arts talent is at the bottom not only among the four major families, but also among ordinary warriors. It is only at the age of fifteen that martial arts has broken through the third level of martial arts.
After entering the door, Lu Zhan put the food on the bedside table. After that, he came to Lu Chen's bedside and asked with concern: "Brother Chen, are you feeling better today?"
Ren Xiaoyao looked at Lu Zhan and asked, "Brother Zhan, what will you do if I just keep lying down like this?"
Lu Zhan said: "Brother Chen, if you keep doing this, I will always take care of you and never let anyone bully you, let alone let you go hungry."
Ren Xiaoyao nodded: "Okay, help me up."
Lu Zhan looked at Lu Chen, who was all wrapped up in rice dumplings, and said worriedly: "Brother Chen, you are seriously injured. You should lie down. Don't disturb the wound. I will feed you."
With that said, Lu Zhan didn't wait for Ren Xiaoyao's consent, picked up the food and fed it to Lu Chen one by one.
Lu Chen didn't refuse and accepted Lu Zhan's care.
Looking at the cautious Lu Zhan in front of him, Ren Xiaoyao felt a little warmer in his heart.
In this world where martial arts is respected, there are many people who follow the trend, but there are too few people who can never leave you when you are in trouble.
Although Lu Chen was miserable, it was good that he had such a brother.
Unknowingly, Ren Xiaoyao thought of his brothers.
A hundred years ago, they were already a giant. Now that a hundred years have passed, he has become a weakling. They should become the strongest in the world of divine martial arts.
Bang!
Suddenly, the door was kicked open, breaking the harmonious atmosphere, and then five men came in menacingly from outside.
The person who kicked the door was a young man with a thin face, in his early twenties, unusually dressed, and a third-level warrior in martial arts.
His name is Lu Ming, and he is the youngest son of Lu Qian, the current head of the Lu family.
The four people who came with him were older, but not as strong as the young men. They were all in the martial arts realm, dressed simply, and were all followers of Lu Ming.
Before Lu Chen was deposed, although Lu Ming was jealous of Lu Chen, he did not dare to be arrogant towards Lu Chen because he was afraid of Lu Chen's strength.
